limitations: Research prototype only: dataset permissions are mixed, including explicit noncommercial research restrictions and unresolved mirror licensing.
Main evaluation mixes real de-identified SMS with case-derived/generated fraud messages/dialogue; report per-source results as well as combinedmetrics.
Converted Traditional Chinese test is a paired orthographic robustness test, not an independent native Hong Kong/Taiwan SMS benchmark.
Script inference uses OpenCC change detection; shared characters do not establish a speaker's region or language variety.
Template clustering is a documented heuristic and cannot guarantee separation of all semantic campaigns/paraphrases.
External Mudou is an original held-out file from a source also contributing normal training rows, not a completely independent source for the normal class.
External IMC Chinese reports are retained unreviewed and are not valid ground truth merely because they were reported as suspicious.
Absence of sender identity or consent prevents determination of legal legitimacy from text alone.
